Introduction

Myu debuted with the group Re:Hearts in 2025 as a vocalist. Before debut, she gained attention as a YouTuber sharing content about makeup, fashion, and lifestyle. Re:Hearts aims to connect with listeners through emotional themes such as loneliness and self-discovery, with their debut single "Reborn" introducing a dreamy and modern sound.
